name: holdLock.release

name: holdLock
reason: Checked: process.kill(pid, 0) is true for a live pid, ESRCH means gone, EPERM means alive; a missing or garbled lock reads as no holder and is taken over.

name: snapshotShared
reason: Intentional: an include folder that does not exist in the shared folder is skipped, and a file that vanishes mid-walk is not copied.

name: tryLock
reason: Intended: a failed rename means another run moved the dead lock first, so the loop tries again; a failed link-back means the lock is already back. Covered by the lock test.

name: tryLock.release
reason: Intended: release runs on exit; if the lock file is gone or unreadable there is nothing to release.

name: alive
reason: process.kill(pid, 0) returns true when the process exists; EPERM also means it exists. A non-positive or NaN pid returns false. Correct.
